title: 71 Home Front Command soldiers, most of them reservists, flew to Mexico City after the earthquake and surveyed 158 buildings

trailer.text: The IDF Home Front Command is one of the teams Israel sends again and again to countries struck by natural disasters, according to the Jerusalem Post.
On September 19, 2017, an earthquake collapsed buildings all over Mexico City, according to the Times of Israel.
The Mexican government requested assistance from Israel, and an Israeli delegation from the Home Front Command, most of whose members were reservists, landed in the city on September 21.
According to an IDF statement, the team surveyed 158 buildings, including hospitals, schools and kindergartens, to check whether they remained structurally sound.
In the streets, residents greeted the Israeli rescuers with applause, according to the Times of Israel.

glance.label: Scope
glance.value: 158 buildings surveyed, according to the IDF

paragraphs.text: On Tuesday, September 19, 2017, an earthquake struck Mexico, according to the Jerusalem Post.
According to the Jerusalem Post, it struck on the anniversary of the 1985 quake, and hours after an earthquake preparedness drill.
Two weeks earlier, a magnitude 8.1 earthquake struck off the Pacific coast of southern Mexico and killed close to 100 people in the states of Oaxaca and Chiapas.
According to the Times of Israel, the earthquake collapsed buildings all over Mexico City.
According to the Times of Israel, about 20,000 homes were damaged, and residents wondered where they would live.
According to Mexico's Education Ministry, as reported by Mako, more than 2,000 public schools were damaged.
Near the collapsed buildings, families pleaded with the authorities not to send in bulldozers as long as there was hope that people were alive, according to the Times of Israel.
According to the Times of Israel, in the Roma neighborhood rescuers pulled 28 survivors from a seven-story office building.
According to ynet, the mayor of Mexico City said that by then 52 people had been rescued alive from the rubble.

stations.title: The Request and the Departure from Israel

paragraphs.text: According to the Times of Israel, the Mexican government requested Israeli assistance and specified two areas: search and rescue alongside local authorities, and mapping the city's buildings.
According to the Jerusalem Post, the Mexican authorities made it clear they did not need search and rescue or medical forces.
According to the Times of Israel, the delegation included soldiers from the IDF Home Front Command, most of them reservists.
About half of its members were engineers, and the rest came from search and rescue, logistics and medical units, according to the same newspaper.
According to ISRAEL21c, it was led by Col. (res.) Dudi Mizrahi of the Home Front Command's search and rescue unit.
According to Mako, the delegation's name is "Kol Shofar LaMerhak".
According to the Jerusalem Post, the team set out from the Nevatim airbase on Wednesday, September 20, aboard an Israel Air Force aircraft.
According to Israel Hayom, the delegation arrived with two Hercules aircraft, one for equipment and one for the rescue personnel.
The team was in the air during Rosh Hashanah, so the IDF chief rabbi granted it special dispensation to travel, according to the Times of Israel.
According to the Times of Israel, the Israeli delegation touched down on September 21 and was one of the first foreign groups to arrive in the city.
According to the Foreign Ministry, as reported by Mako, it was the fourth foreign delegation, after delegations from Honduras, El Salvador and Panama.
According to ynet, on Thursday the delegation set out to assist in rescue efforts at three collapsed buildings in the Ksonda neighborhood.
Local rescuers said, according to the Times of Israel, that the Israeli teams came with equipment enabling them to detect cell phone signals under the rubble.
According to the Times of Israel, the primary mission was to help local officials assess the structural integrity of the city's buildings.
According to the IDF, as reported in the Forward, by Sunday morning, September 24, the delegation had surveyed 59 buildings.
An IDF statement reported in the Times of Israel said the team surveyed 158 buildings, including hospitals, schools, kindergartens and government offices.
According to the Jerusalem Post, Mizrahi told Defense Minister Liberman that the delegation had worked on a number of large sites.
According to the Algemeiner, on Monday, September 25, the team was working at the site of a collapsed six-story building.
Col. (res.) Gili Shenhar said that day that so far they had not managed to pull anyone out alive, but had found bodies and brought them to the families.
Shenhar said most of the city's buildings were not damaged, some would need reconstruction, and a smaller number would need to be torn down and rebuilt.
According to ISRAEL21c, residents lining the streets of Mexico City greeted the Israeli rescuers with cheers, applause and shouts of "gracias".
In a video published by Channel 2 News, dozens of people, some waving Mexican flags, can be seen cheering the Israeli team.
Mizrahi said that when the team arrives at a site, people stand and applaud it.
Shenhar said people on the street recognize the Israelis immediately and say they are happy they arrived.

stations.title: Calls from Home, and a Farewell Ceremony

paragraphs.text: According to Israel Hayom, Netanyahu told the delegation: "You are shining Israel's light in the world, with a great light".
Defense Minister Liberman told the delegation, according to Israel Hayom, that he was receiving responses from Mexico to its activity and that it had created a very positive echo.

IDF Spokesperson Lt. Col. Jonathan Conricus said the IDF and the State of Israel would continue to assist in the aftermath of any disaster around the world that requires their experience and abilities.
According to the Times of Israel, Israeli delegations also provided assistance after an earthquake in Turkey in 1999, in Haiti in 2010, and after a typhoon in the Philippines in 2013.
According to the Times of Israel, the team ended its stay in Mexico with a ceremony at which it was thanked for its search, rescue and recovery operations.
According to Mako, it was decided to bring Israel's Paralympic swimming team back on the aid plane that had brought the delegation.

stations.title: More Israelis and Jews on the Ground

paragraphs.text: According to the Jerusalem Post, non-military organizations, including ZAKA and iAID, joined the rescue efforts, working with the IDF delegation and local officials.
According to ISRAEL21c, volunteers from IsraAID, ZAKA and iAID provided rescue services and material and psychosocial assistance in Mexico.
According to the Jerusalem Post, iAID sent 15 members of its international emergency response team.
According to the Jerusalem Post, ZAKA has trained 70 volunteers in Mexico City since September 2016.
According to JTA in the Forward, ZAKA volunteers located the body of a local rabbi in a collapsed office building.
According to JTA, Rabbi Haim Ashkenazi had been working in the building when the earthquake struck.
According to the Jerusalem Post, the American Jewish Joint Distribution Committee supported its Mexican-Jewish partner CADENA on the ground in search, rescue and emergency aid.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, ארגונים לא צבאיים, ובהם זק"א ו-iAID, הצטרפו למאמצי החילוץ במקסיקו בשיתוף עם משלחת צה"ל והרשויות המקומיות.
claims.quote: Non-military teams, including ZAKA and iAID, also have joined in the rescue efforts in Mexico, working with the IDF delegation and local officials.

claims.text: לפי ישראל21סי, מתנדבים מארגוני הסיוע הישראליים IsraAID, זק"א ו-iAID פעלו במקסיקו וסיפקו שירותי חילוץ וסיוע חומרי ופסיכו-סוציאלי.
claims.quote: volunteers from nongovernmental Israeli humanitarian-aid agencies IsraAID, ZAKA and iAID are in Mexico providing rescue services and material and psychosocial assistance

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, ארגון iAID שלח למקסיקו 15 חברים מצוות התגובה החירום הבינלאומי שלו.
claims.quote: which sent 15 members of its international emergency response team to Mexico.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, מאז ספטמבר 2016 הכשיר זק"א 70 מתנדבים במקסיקו סיטי.
claims.quote: Since September 2016, ZAKA has trained 70 Mexico City-based volunteers.

claims.text: לפי JTA בפורוורד, מתנדבי זק"א הישראלי איתרו בבניין משרדים שקרס במקסיקו את גופתו של רב מקומי.
claims.quote: search and rescue organization recovered from a collapsed office building in Mexico the body of a local rabbi

claims.text: לפי JTA, הרב חיים אשכנזי עבד בבניין המשרדים כשרעידת האדמה בעוצמה 7.1 פגעה במרכז מקסיקו ביום שלישי אחר הצהריים.
claims.quote: Rabbi Haim Ashkenazi had been working in the office building when the 7.1-magnitude earthquake struck central Mexico on Tuesday afternoon

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, ועד הג'וינט האמריקאי היה בשטח וסייע לשותפו היהודי-מקסיקני CADENA במאמצי חיפוש, חילוץ וסיוע חירום.
claims.quote: The American Jewish Joint Distribution Committee also was on the ground, having provided immediate support to the search, rescue and emergency aid efforts of CADENA

claims.text: לפי ynet מ-21.9.2017, רעידת האדמה במקסיקו הרגה לפחות 250 בני אדם ופצעה יותר מ-2,000.
claims.quote: לפחות 250 הרוגים ויותר מ-2,000 פצועים. זו השורה התחתונה והכואבת של רעידת האדמה הקשה במקסיקו

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל מסוף השבוע של 23.9.2017, הרעידה הרגה כמעט 300 בני אדם והרסה עשרות מבנים.
claims.quote: Israeli rescuers were taking part in the search for survivors in Mexico this weekend following a devastating earthquake Tuesday that has killed nearly 300 people and destroyed dozens of buildings.

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל, ביום רביעי (27.9.2017) העלו הרשויות את מספר ההרוגים ל-338.
claims.quote: Authorities on Wednesday raised the death toll in the qauke to 338.

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל, הרעידה הפילה לפחות 38 בניינים בבירה, ופעולות החיפוש נמשכו בחלק מהאתרים.
claims.quote: The quake collapsed at least 38 buildings in the capital, and search efforts were continuing at some sites.

claims.text: לפי מאקו, בסך הכול קרסו בעיר מקסיקו סיטי 46 בניינים.
claims.quote: המשלחת הישראלית פועלת בשניים מתוך 38 מאמצי החילוץ בעיר, כשקיים חשש ללכודים בבית הספר, שנפגע קשות ברעידה. סך הכל קרסו בעיר 46 בניינים.

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל, רעידת האדמה ב-1985 הרסה את מקסיקו סיטי והרגה יותר מ-10,000 בני אדם.
claims.quote: a massive earthquake that devastated Mexico City in 1985, killing more than 10,000 people

claims.text: לפי ynet, בבית ספר שקרס נהרגו לפחות 21 תלמידים וחמישה מבוגרים.
claims.quote: בסך הכול בבית ספר נהרגו לפחות 21 תלמידים וחמישה מבוגרים.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, בקריסת בית ספר במקסיקו סיטי נהרגו לפחות 22 ילדים ושני מבוגרים.
claims.quote: The earthquake also caused major structural damage, including the collapse of a school in Mexico City that killed at least 22 children and two adults.

claims.text: אל"מ (מיל') מזרחי סיפר לשר הביטחון ליברמן שהמשלחת מונה 70 איש ורובה אנשי מילואים.
claims.quote: המשלחת מונה 70 איש, והחלק הארי של המשלחת הוא אנשי מילואים

claims.text: לפי ישראל21סי, המשלחת מנתה כ-70 גברים ונשים, ובהם 25 מהנדסים שמעריכים את הנזק.
claims.quote: The IDF delegation of approximately 70 men and women includes 25 engineers who are evaluating the damage

claims.text: לפי האלגמיינר, חברי המשלחת ארזו ציוד לקראת מסע של 20 שעות למקסיקו, ערב ראש השנה.
claims.quote: were packing their equipment ahead of a 20-hour journey to Mexico, where they were being dispatched to provide assistance in the wake of the deadly Sept. 19 earthquake

claims.text: לפי ישראל21סי, הישראלים הגיעו למקסיקו אחרי טיסה של 18 שעות מישראל, בתגובה לסדרת רעידות אדמה קטלניות.
claims.quote: after an 18-hour flight from Israel in response to a series of deadly earthquakes

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל, משלחת של 71 חברים מפיקוד העורף הגיעה למקסיקו ביום חמישי, כ-48 שעות אחרי הרעידה בעוצמה 7.1.
claims.quote: A 71-member Israeli delegation from the Home Front Command arrived in Mexico on Thursday, some 48 hours after the 7.1-magnitude quake hit.

claims.text: לפי ynet, סא"ל איתמר כהן, מפקד כוח חילוץ, אמר שההגעה למקסיקו סיטי 36 שעות אחרי הרעידה.
claims.quote: מפקד כוח חילוץ, אמר כי ההגעה למקסיקו סיטי 36 שעות אחרי הרעש עצמו

claims.text: לפי הצבא כפי שדווח בטיימס אוף ישראל, הצוות היה אמור להגיע חזרה לישראל ביום חמישי (28.9.2017).
claims.quote: The team was scheduled to arrive back in the country on Thursday, the army said in a statement.

claims.text: לפי טיימס אוף ישראל, המשלחת הייתה אמורה לחזור ב-29 בספטמבר, לפני יום כיפור.
claims.quote: The delegation is slated to return on September 29, ahead of the Yom Kippur holiday, the spokesperson said.

claims.text: לפי ynet, משלחת השחייה הישראלית לאליפות העולם לנכים כללה שישה שחיינים, מאמן ושלושה מלווים.
claims.quote: משלחת השחייה הישראלית, המונה שישה שחיינים (בהם המדליסטית האולימפית ענבל פיזרו), מאמן ושלושה מלווים, תשוב

claims.text: לפי מאקו, נבחרת השחייה הפראלימפית כללה שישה שחיינים, מאמן ושני מלווים.
claims.quote: הנבחרת, בה שישה שחיינים, מאמן ושני מלווים, הגיעה למקסיקו סיטי לפני מספר ימים

claims.text: לפי ישראל21סי, תושבים שעמדו לאורך רחובות מקסיקו סיטי קיבלו את המחלצים הישראלים בתשואות, במחיאות כפיים ובקריאות "גרסיאס".
claims.quote: greeted with cheers, applause and shouts of “gracias” from citizens lining the streets in Mexico City

claims.text: ג'רוזלם פוסט: מטוס "ראם" של חיל האוויר, שיצא מבסיס נבטים
claims.quote: set out from the Nevatim airbase on Wednesday aboard a 'Re'em' IAF aircraft

claims.quote: הגיעה עם שני הרקולסים - אחד לציוד והשני לאנשי החילוץ

quote_translations.c66: The mayor of Mexico City, Miguel Ángel Mancera, said that so far 52 people have been rescued alive from the rubble
quote_translations.c20: The aid delegation arrived with two Hercules aircraft - one for equipment and the other for the rescue personnel
quote_translations.c12: The Foreign Ministry stated that the Israeli delegation is the fourth foreign delegation to arrive in Mexico, after delegations from the neighboring countries - Honduras, El Salvador and Panama.
quote_translations.c25: The delegation numbers 71 soldiers and officers and set out to assist in rescue efforts at three collapsed buildings in the Ksonda neighborhood
quote_translations.c26: When we arrive at a site, people stand and applaud us. We brought the cutting edge of technology here
quote_translations.c33: You are shining Israel's light in the world, with a great light. It is important in humanitarian terms, and also so that they will see the real Israel
quote_translations.c34: I am receiving responses from Mexico to your activity, chapeau. You created a very positive echo, a tremendous echo.
quote_translations.c69: It was decided to bring the team back home on the special aid plane that brought the Home Front Command and Foreign Ministry delegation to the country
quote_translations.c51: At least 250 dead and more than 2,000 injured. This is the painful bottom line of the severe earthquake in Mexico
quote_translations.c55: The Israeli delegation is operating in two of the 38 rescue efforts in the city, with fears of people trapped in the school, which was badly damaged in the earthquake. In total, 46 buildings collapsed in the city.
quote_translations.c63: In total, at least 21 students and five adults were killed in the school.
quote_translations.c14: The delegation numbers 70 people, and the bulk of the delegation are reservists
quote_translations.c24: A rescue force commander said that the arrival in Mexico City was 36 hours after the quake itself
quote_translations.c67: The Israeli swimming delegation, numbering six swimmers (among them Olympic medalist Inbal Pezaro), a coach and three escorts, will return
quote_translations.c68: The team, with six swimmers, a coach and two escorts, arrived in Mexico City a few days ago
